subject.title: feat(agents): add multi-pass context compaction with progress tracking

question: Should this PR keep an internal, unintegrated multi-pass compaction orchestrator in core now, or should it narrow to the already-wired pruning and summary-boundary changes until the architecture is ready?
rationale: The code can be mechanically repaired, but the larger choice is whether OpenClaw wants to merge dormant multi-pass architecture and public-ish settings before production integration and successor-transcript behavior are settled.

options.title: Narrow Before Merge
options.body: Remove the inert public/internal multi-pass settings and either fix or drop the unintegrated multi-pass helper until production wiring is ready.

options.title: Sponsor Full Integration
options.body: Keep the multi-pass direction only if a maintainer wants this PR to wire it into real callers with successor transcript, timeout, upgrade, and real-run proof.

options.title: Pause For Architecture Issue
options.body: Use the open compaction architecture discussion as the canonical place for the multi-pass design and close or park this branch if it is not worth carrying.

recommendation.title: Narrow Before Merge
recommendation.body: Remove the inert public/internal multi-pass settings and either fix or drop the unintegrated multi-pass helper until production wiring is ready.

likelyOwner.reason: She is the live assignee on this PR and can route the merge-shape decision to the right compaction/context-engine owner.
